performance_requirements: Primary SLAs: steady-state throughput guarantee for chat workload: 400-600 RPS (short-turn chat, <=256 tokens) with p95 < 100ms and p99 < 250ms. For longer form prompts (<=2048 tokens) target p50 < 500ms, p99 < 2s. Soak requirement: 7-day continuous load at 50% peak to verify stability. Burst tolerance: up to 2x provisioned capacity for 15 minutes with graceful degradation to fallback model variant.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial capacity ask: 8 x H100-80GB as primary preferred hardware (NVLink topology) for production baseline; fallback proposal: 16 x A100-80GB. Plan includes headroom for autoscale bursts + reserved slots for priority routes. Will evaluate packing with mixed-precision and int8 quantized variants to reduce GPU count.
poc_plan: Phase 0 - Baseline: small-scale config to validate correctness and sample latency for chosen model variants (scheduled 2026-02-20 to 2026-02-24)
Phase 1 - Load tests: incremental RPS ramps to 600 RPS, capture p50/p95/p99, throughput, token efficiency (2026-02-27 to 2026-03-05)
Phase 2 - Soak test: 7-day continuous run at 50% peak with periodic burst events to validate mem leaks and throttling (proposed 2026-03-06 to 2026-03-13)
Phase 3 - Failure and fallback: simulate node loss, region failover, and validate automated fallback to cheaper model variants and routing policies (2026-03-14)
Phase 4 - Handover & SLA draft: collate metrics, confirm reserved GPU sizing, and finalize SLA language for procurement (target 2026-03-20)
soak_test_criteria: No sustained growth in p99 over 5% during 7-day soak; no memory leak (>2% cumulative increase over 24h); error rate <0.05%; autoscale events logged and within policy thresholds.
representative_prompts: Operator: 'Machine 17 spindle temperature rising — summarize probable causes and first-step checks.'
ServiceChat: 'Customer: My pump is making high-pitched noise at startup — prioritize troubleshooting steps and parts list.'
SearchAssist: 'Find latest maintenance procedure for model XQ-9, include embed links and steps.'
AnomalyRank: 'Given 20 telemetry events, rerank the top 5 likely faults for engineer triage.'
